Results.ReviewText:
So one of the major wishes for this grill is that if you wanted the grill lid to flip up and away in its rack, 
 so that the entire work surface could be available, its not possible if you keep the grill near the end of a deck or yard. As it is you will need to have at least 90 to 18O degrees of access or a place to set the lid down while tending to the grill..  A front lid handle might help.  Additionally, if you are space limited you will want to carefully think about alignment of the lower grill elements to assure convenient access to flue opening and ash removal.  Something not discussed in the assembly instructions.
Results.Title: A great grill but....

Results.ReviewText: Overall the grill works great, but two things I wish were improved. First, the legs are wobbly. Weber Customer service is excellent and they sent me new legs, but that was not the issue. The female receivers the legs snap into should be built stronger. You can see the receivers flex/move as the grill wobbles. Second, the lid holder ring is designed in such a way that it holds the lid at an angle over top of the cooking surface. This makes it hard to work the part of the grill under the lid and also throws more smoke an heat at you rather than straight up. If the lid sat at a 90 degree angle it would be better. I like the grill, and the price is reasonable, I just think there is some room for improvement.
Results.Title: Good grill but room for improvement

Results.ReviewText: Great improvements to this Weber. It's the little things that were addressed that I liked. I highly recommend one of in the market.
Results.Title: Grillin papa san

Results.ReviewText:
Honestly just a solid all-around grill. It is especially great for people just getting into charcoal grilling who want a simple, straight-forward grilling experience. All the new little updates are very handy. 

I don’t usually spend time making reviews unless the product is pretty trashy, or else really impressive- I’m happy to say this product is the latter!
Results.Title: Would DEFINITELY recommend.

Results.ReviewText: Bought the 22 inch master touch to replace my original 22 inch that lasted over 40 years.  Two of the welded leg supports finally gave up so I needed a new charcoal BBQ, never considered any other brand as any BBQ I used before gave up way before the Weber.  On the new BBQ the cover holder was bent and a screw was stripped, was very easy to report problem on website and got replacement parts in a few days.
Results.Title: Replaced 40 year old 22 inch grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to clean and versatile i have smoked a brisket grilled burgers and chicken. I am smoking pork today.

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear you had a difficult time assembling the grill legs. We recommend using the BILT app as a great tool to assemble any grill. If you need any further assistance please let us know. We are here to help. Thank you for being a loyal Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: assembly of the 22inch grill is fustrating and near impossible to assemble. the assembly instructions are a aeries of drawings, no text. the leg diameter is larger than the 'tube' where the legs fit into the bottom of the kettle. i spent over 2 hours trying to assemble the legs. finally using pipe wrenches, yes 2 pipe wrenches and a hammet i was able to twist the metal legs into place. i would not recommend trying to assemble this piece of work. the leg design needs to be redone. what i have is a nice bbq kettle with twisted legs. wouldn't purchase again unless preassembled!
Results.Title: krappy leg design

Results.ReviewText: Very impressed with my Weber Grill I have smoked a brisket and and turkey on it worked out great.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText:
The Master Touch is be bomb! All the iconic grilling prowess of the original kettle with the conveniences grandpa always dreamed of: ash collector (no more dust storms with any breeze), dampers with handles, and the ash cleaning system is downright genius.
The updated grill, warming rack and charcoal trays pretty much give you all you need to start grilling out of the box. Ten minutes of easy assembly and you’re ready to go. Grill On!
Results.Title: Not your Grandpa’s Weber

Results.ReviewText: My third Weber and it’s my favorite so far. First kettle lasted forever then had a small version which after many years I gave away. This one has many features my others did not have an it makes a difference. The color really pops too!
Results.Title: Best Yet

Results.ReviewText: Great purchase. I own a variety of grills and use my Weber quite often. Used it for hot and fast cooks, as well as low and slow. Definitely worth the money! The grill travels well. Lightweight and very portable.
Results.Title: Great purchase

Results.ReviewText: I have always loved Weber kettle grills and this one is fantastic.
Results.Title: Awesome

Results.ReviewText: It has been years since I used a charcoal grill. Gas seems to be the “easy way out” for bbq’ing. But I didn’t know it was going to be this easy, and this rewarding. Using the chimney to get things started is life saver! And the flavour and temperature control my Weber gives me makes grilling with real charcoal an absolute must! I love this grill!!
Results.Title: Flavour flavour flavour!

Results.ReviewText: It is much easier for me to use this one than the lower line models.  It is taller, more sturdy, and has all of the options that I want--STANDARD!  And charcoal ash clean up is a breeze with the combination vent and sweeper, and the ash catcher.   This is going to be getting a lot of use this fall and winter with all of the holidays--and weekends!
Results.Title: Getting the top of the line was worth the money

Results.ReviewText: We enjoyed the Indirect Cooking using the two Char Baskets, along with the ease of starting the coals with starter tabs.  We smoked burgers and chicken on the 22".  Very good buy for the money.
Results.Title: Master Griller in the making!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill/ have three grills and this is my best one love the charcoal for cooking leaves a great taste
Results.Title: Best grill I have owned

Results.ReviewText:
Great Kettle - Poor Weber policy! I purchased this kettle through a distributor, my local Ace hardware. Was very happy with purchase and their help in choosing the right one for us. By the way - we own 4 Weber kettles (my daughter has 1 and this is our third!).

However, I tried buying the smoke ring and diffuser after since the Ace didn’t have that add on.   After searching online and even calling Weber two different times, including the support and then sales, I was told since I didn’t buy it direct from Weber, I couldn’t buy the smoke ring!   Really - so you don’t support your local distributors?

It really tainted the brand. 

The kettle is fine, but the thermometer placement seems to be on the wrong side of the grill. (Should be near the vent). Very disappointed with Weber.
Results.Title: Great Kettle - Poor Weber policy!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome.  The charcoal trays, cleanout and lid holder sets it apart.  Very easy to assemble and it cooks food great.
Results.Title: This is the one to maximize grilling.

Results.ReviewText: This has been a great experiment for me, I abandoned charcoal decades ago in favor of gas grills. While I love the immediacy of gas, walk out, click start it and in five minutes you're cookin'. With that said there is something primal to using this Weber Kettle. First, it's intentional, you have to plan for it.  Second, It brings me back to warm Minnesota summer days. My dad and I would sit on the back patio and grill a chicken while talking, sharing a Grain Belt beer and listening to the Minnesota Twins play-by-play on the radio. It was more of a shared event... and the end result was almost as good as the company.
Results.Title: A Shared Event

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this grill! I have had it a month now and have used it almost every night. I look for reasons to use it. I’m impressed with how well the lid seals and holds temps. I used the snake method for a shoulder and it help perfect temps for 7 hours. This is by far the most versatile grill I have ever used and a MUST HAVE for anyone’s collection!
Results.Title: Stop thinking and buy this grill!!

Results.ReviewText: I am so happy I ponied up and went with the Master Touch! Gourmet BBQ System, warming rack, coal baskets and the colors!
Results.Title: Master Touch for the Win

Results.ReviewText: It cooks as it should. Color change is nice.  5stars
Results.Title: Same Weber grill we grown to love !

Results.ReviewText: After years of cooking on a Weber gas grill I realized I was missing the flavor of charcoal and wood so I decided to switch back. Best decision I have made , the versatile cooking options makes grilling easy and fun . I would highly recommend the Weber Master Touch to anyone.
Results.Title: Outstanding grill

Results.ReviewText: I grew up watching my dad grill on his Weber kettle, so when it came time to buy a new grill for myself, the Weber kettle immediately came to mind. Once I found out that you can easily smoke low and slow as well as do hot and fast cooks, it was a done deal. I don't think you can find anything out there on the market that is as versatile at this price point (or any other for that matter).
Results.Title: Best and most versatile grill out there!

Results.ReviewText: I bought a Master Touch earlier this year, I had an issue where the plastic damper knob melted on the first use and I could not move the damper.  After discussing this,  Weber replaced the lid free of charge!
Results.Title: My Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: I have had several kettle grills from weber over the years and have let them get away during different moves. After getting a pellet grill for the convenience, I realized they`re not so convenient and the flavor is not anywhere close to what you get from Charcoal and the Weber Kettle. I have had better grilling, smoking and reverse searing from my new Weber Kettle grill than from my pellet grill and my stick burner which I`m selling. The Weber kettle is more conveniently sized, easier to clean out than the pellet smoker and provides a better smoking, grilling and searing experience than any other out door cooking device I`ve used.
Results.Title: My Weber Kettle.

Results.ReviewText: I have used Weber grills since the early 1980's.  I have always loved the quality of the grills and the functioning.  I had purchased a different model of Weber grill several months ago and wasn't as pleased with that particular model as compared to other Weber grills I've had in the past.   Weber customer service reached out to me concerning this and offered a way for me to exchange for a model I was more accustomed to.   I've never had any doubt about the great grills they offer but I've found their superior customer service behind the product.  I am very pleased with Weber.
Results.Title: Great grills and Wonderful customer service

Results.ReviewText: Very impressive design.  I have always liked the quality of weber products.  I have used weber chaircoal grills in the past.  The design is well thought out.  My one concern is the top hamdle broke and I am in the process of getting a replacement.
Results.Title: x

Results.ReviewText: Great grill I had the base model years ago and have missed it since it died.  The updates of the lid holder and including the charcoal bins are great. I really like the beefy grates but the removable center is a pain. When starting the grill where do I place the grate? The ash removal system is clean and works fantastic. Personally I would like a beefier bottom shelf but that is splitting hairs. Great grill and I love the deep blue color
Results.Title: Upgraded from basic very pkeased

Results.ReviewText: A quality Weber product that we all know and trust. Every time I grill it takes me to another time and place.
Results.Title: Doesn’t disappoint.

Results.ReviewText: Only cooked a chicken and hamburgers on it so far but love it
Results.Title: Love my Master-Touch

Results.ReviewText: J'en suis très content peut ajuster la température durant la cuisson
Results.Title: Super facile à utilisé

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the pinnacle of the kettle grills. I really like the additional height and the lid bale that makes it convenient to get in and check on your food.
Results.Title: Great grill all types of cooking

Results.ReviewText: EXCELLENT GRILL! Love all the features and the color is gorgeous. Mine was missing the grill handle when I received it but Customer Service was excellent and speedy. My only complaint is there is a huge mark in the paint job about 10" long... I understand they are handpainted and there are deviations but this is very long and obvious and should have been caught at inspection before it was fired. I needed the grill for a get-together and did not have time to get a replacement so I went ahead and kept it... thankfully the huge mark is on the back side of the grill, but I hate knowing it's there for as much money as I spent on what will be a long-term purchase.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is our third Weber grill we are generally happy with it so far.  Our only compaint was with assembing the grill legs.  It was very hard to insert them due to the paint binding. We even tried appling oil to them. It finally took grabbing and lifting and slamming each leg down into the kettle bottom. Twisting did not work as per the instructions and we did not want to hammer on them. What was supposed to take minutes took much longer.
Results.Title: Some assembly challenges

Results.ReviewText: Very well made, just like my old one 20+ years and still using it.
Results.Title: Cooking with charcoal

Results.ReviewText: I've grilled burgers & steak so far with very good results.  Hoping to do a longer smoke with it in the future.  My only complaint might be that I would like the legs a little sturdier.  I will add that Weber has very good customer service.
Results.Title: Nice Grill

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
